textes.Vous décrivez le problème en moins d’une: You describe the problem in under a minute. We pick the right firm from our local network, we compare the quotes, and we follow the work through to completion. You pay us nothing.
textes.Le formulaire, de la première question à: The form, from the first question to the confirmation
textes.Choisissez la situation qui ressemble à: Pick the situation closest to yours. The form adapts, and never asks for more than it needs.
textes.Fuite qui coule, plus d’électricité, por: Water running, no power, a door that won’t open, damage happening now. You are put straight through to the nearest on-call firm.
textes.Quelque chose fonctionne mal, et cela pe: Something isn’t working properly, and it can wait until tomorrow. We call you back the same day to arrange the visit.
textes.Rénovation, salle de bains, cuisine, rav: Renovation, bathroom, kitchen, façade work, communal areas. Several firms quote against the same specification.
textes.Pompe à chaleur, isolation, fenêtres, so: Heat pump, insulation, windows, solar. We work out your funding before quoting, never after.
textes.Vous êtes une commune, une intercommunal: Are you a local authority, a social landlord or a public body? The form has a dedicated route, with competitive tendering of three quotes or more.
textes.Quatre étapes, et vous n’en faites qu’un: Four steps, and you take only one
textes.prend moins d’une minute. Une photo remp: takes less than a minute. One photo replaces ten questions, and is often enough to quote without a visit.
textes.L’entreprise qui convient au métier, à l: The firm that fits the trade, the town and the deadline — from those whose insurance file is up to date with us.
textes.Plusieurs entreprises chiffrent sur un d: Several firms quote against a single specification. The quotes compare line by line, and we negotiate before passing them on to you.
textes.Jusqu’à la réception des travaux, avec l: Through to sign-off, with photographs of the finished work. One point of contact from start to finish.
The quote and the invoice are in your name.
textes.Nous ne réalisons pas les travaux et nou: We do not carry out the work and we sell nothing. The firm issues its quote directly to you, the choice remains yours, and you pay us nothing. We are paid by the firm, on work actually carried out.
textes.pour revenir vers vous, au plus tard: to come back to you, at the latest
textes.Propriétaires et locataires, en appartem: Owners and tenants, in flats and houses alike. From a dripping tap to a full renovation.
textes.Nous prenons les appels techniques de vo: We take the maintenance calls from your buildings, we find the firms, and we send you a summary every month.
textes.Ravalement, cage d’escalier, toiture, ch: Façades, stairwells, roofs, boiler rooms. Comparable quotes, ready to present at the general meeting.
textes.Mise en concurrence organisée, devis au: Organised tendering, quotes in a single format, compliance documents checked and attached.
textes.VD Services a été fondée à Mandelieu-la-: VD Services was founded in Mandelieu-la-Napoule by Valentin Dupuy, to solve a problem everybody knows:
textes.trouver la bonne entreprise, obtenir un: finding the right firm, getting a quote, and making sure the work is done properly.
textes.Notre métier, c’est le réseau et la méth: Our trade is the network and the method. Every partner firm keeps a current file with us: ten-year structural insurance, public liability, URSSAF compliance certificate. When a request comes in, we pick the firm that fits the trade, the town and the deadline.
textes.Nous faisons chiffrer sur un descriptif: We have everyone quote against a single specification so the prices can be compared. And we stay reachable until the job is finished.
textes.J’ai monté VD Services parce que j’ai pa: I started VD Services because I spent years watching people lose weeks over a quote, and good tradespeople lose days on enquiries that led nowhere. Somebody was missing in between.
textes.De Fréjus à Nice, arrière-pays inclus: Fréjus to Nice, inland towns included

textes.Avis recueillis auprès de clients de VD: Reviews collected from VD Services clients after their work was signed off, published with their consent.
textes.Vous êtes artisan ou entreprise du bâtim: You are a tradesperson or a building firm in the area, and you are looking for qualified work — not a race to the lowest bid.
textes.Des demandes qualifiées de votre métier,: Qualified enquiries in your trade, in your town, with the address, the nature of the job and photographs.
textes.Un interlocuteur unique qui a déjà parlé: A single contact who has already spoken to the client and checked the enquiry is genuine.
textes.Un descriptif clair pour chiffrer, au li: A clear specification to price against, instead of a vague phone call and a wasted trip.
textes.Aucun droit d’entrée, aucun abonnement,: No joining fee, no subscription, no exclusivity imposed.
textes.Assurances à jour : décennale, responsab: Current insurance: ten-year structural cover, public liability, URSSAF compliance certificate.
textes.Une réponse sous quarante-huit heures, m: A reply within forty-eight hours, even if it is a no.
textes.Les rendez-vous tenus, et le client prév: Appointments kept, and the client told if you are running late.
textes.Un chantier laissé propre, et une photo: A site left clean, and a photograph of the finished work.
textes.Une commission d’apport d’affaires, payé: An introducer’s commission, paid by you, only on work actually carried out and paid for. Nothing to pay to join the network, nothing up front, and nothing at all if the job does not happen.
textes.Le taux se fixe ensemble au moment de la: The rate is agreed together when we sign the agreement, based on your trade, your margins and the volume we bring you. We discuss it at the first meeting, before you sign anything.
textes.Deux minutes. Nous rappelons sous quaran: Two minutes. We call back within forty-eight hours.

textes.<p><strong>Qui paie ?</strong> Les vende: Who pays? Energy suppliers. The energy savings certificate scheme obliges them to fund work that lowers their own customers' consumption.
textes.<p>Carburants, fioul, gaz, électricité :: Fuel, heating oil, gas, electricity: TotalEnergies, EDF, Engie and the fuel retailers are what the scheme calls the obliged parties. If they do not fund enough work, they pay a penalty to the State.
textes.<p>Ce financement se cumule avec les aid: This funding stacks with public renovation grants. The amount depends on the work, the property and the household's income: it is worked out case by case, before the quote is signed.
textes.<p class=\"loi\">Loi n° 2005-781 du 13 j: French Act no. 2005-781 of 13 July 2005, articles L. 221-1 et seq. of the Energy Code.
textes.Devis déjà signé : la plupart des aides: Quote already signed: most grants must be applied for beforehand. Check this first, it is the blocking point.
textes.Locataire : les aides se demandent par l: Tenant: the grants are applied for by the owner. They must be brought in before any pricing.
textes.Parties communes : dossier au nom du syn: Communal areas: the application is in the owners' association's name, with a vote at the general meeting, and a scheme specific to managed buildings.
textes.Logement de moins de deux ans : les prin: Property under two years old: the main renovation grants do not apply.
textes.Résidence secondaire : l'aide principale: Second home: the main State grant is reserved for main residences. Energy savings certificates remain available.
textes.Profil éligible à l'aide principale de l: Profile eligible for the main State renovation grant, subject to the rates in force and an RGE-certified firm.
textes.Certificats d'économies d'énergie, finan: Energy savings certificates, funded by the energy suppliers: stackable and open to all income levels.
textes.Sortie d'une énergie fossile vers une po: Moving off a fossil fuel to a heat pump or wood pellets: the best-supported case, with enhanced grants.
textes.Revenus modestes : taux d'aide majorés e: Lower income: enhanced grant rates, and an advance on costs under some schemes.
textes.Plusieurs gestes ou passoire énergétique: Several measures, or a poorly rated property: large-scale renovation route, with a mandatory audit and support adviser. Full coordination work.
textes.TVA réduite sur les travaux d'améliorati: Reduced VAT on energy improvement work, and an interest-free loan for a main residence.
textes.Aides locales de la région, du départeme: Local grants from the region, the department and the town: to be checked case by case, they often stack.
textes.Montants et conditions à confirmer à la: Amounts and conditions to be confirmed at the visit. The rates change every year: no figure should be quoted before checking.
